# Contributing to Hardcover

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="astro-opzsrvew astro-c6vsoqas" /> <span class="astro-opzsrvew">Questi contenuti non sono ancora disponibili nella tua lingua.</span>

<div class="sl-markdown-content">

Welcome to the Hardcover contributing guide! This is where you can find all the information you need to get started contributing to the Hardcover project. Whether you’re a developer, book enthusiast, or just someone who wants to help out, we welcome your contributions!

## Contributing Guides
